summary.text: Yoni Anijar is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 100 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Michael Ferguson in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Anijar won the August 18, 2026 Republican primary with 37.6% of the vote (4,075 votes), defeating Chris Vincent, Eric Stelnicki and Raul Gallon.
